notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Lithoform Engine.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mechanized Production's ability, creating a token copy of Lithoform Engine.
Activate the Lithoform Engine token's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Lithoform Engine token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
